summary: The contract is valid. Living there digitally is the part that asks.

items.note: A Korean mobile number is not a condition of a valid lease.
The Ministry of Land's published processing items for electronic contracts include name, resident or alien registration number, address and mobile number.

items.task: Management office apps, entrance apps, parcel alerts, parking registration, fee payment
items.note: The number reappears at every one of these after move-in.
Paper contracts and counter service still exist.

source: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport — real-estate electronic contract system, published personal data processing items
